tool_schemas.name: search_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Searches the contacts synced for the specified WhatsApp account using a free-text query across indexed fields (for example display name, push name, E.164 phone, and contact JID) and returns a paginated list ordered by the requested sort; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is not a wa_acct_… ULID, query is empty, limit is outside 1–200, cursor is malformed, or sort/is_business are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to access the account.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to search within (wa_acct_... ULID).

query.description: Free-text query matched against contact fields like display_name, push_name, phone_e164, and contact_jid.

is_business.description: If set, only return contacts matching business flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists messages stored for a given chat in a WhatsApp account, optionally filtered by direction, type, delivery_status, and an (after, before) timestamp window, and returns a paginated result set sorted by timestamp_* using limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/chat_id are not valid ULIDs, limit is outside 1–200, cursor is malformed, timestamps are invalid (including after >= before), or any enum filter is not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or chat does not exist (or the chat does not belong to the account), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to read messages for that account.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id owning the messages (wa_acct_... ULID).

chat_id.description: Chat id to list messages for (wa_chat_... ULID).

before.description: Only return messages with timestamp strictly before this time.

after.description: Only return messages with timestamp strictly after this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_chats
tool_schemas.description: Lists chats synced for the specified WhatsApp account with optional filtering by chat type, status, archived/muted flags, unread state, and updated_after, returning a paginated list sorted by the requested sort using limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid, limit is outside 1–200, cursor or updated_after is malformed, has_unread is not boolean, or any enum filter/sort is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to access the account’s chats.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to list chats for (wa_acct_... ULID).

is_archived.description: If set, only return chats matching archived flag.

is_muted.description: If set, only return chats matching muted flag.

has_unread.description: If true, only return chats with unread_count > 0; if false, only return chats with unread_count = 0.

updated_after.description: Only return chats updated after this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of chats to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_chat
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single chat record by chat_id within the given WhatsApp account and returns the chat’s stored metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/chat_id are not valid wa_acct_/wa_chat_ ULIDs. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or chat does not exist (or the chat is not owned by the account), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the account.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id that owns the chat (wa_acct_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: get_message_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the target message plus up to before_limit messages immediately before and after_limit messages immediately after it within the same chat context, using the message’s timestamp/order as stored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/message_id are invalid, or before_limit/after_limit are outside 0–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or message does not exist (or the message is not owned by the account), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to read message history for the account.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id that owns the message (wa_acct_... ULID).

message_id.description: Local message id to fetch context for (wa_msg_... ULID).

before_limit.description: Number of messages to include before the target message.

after_limit.description: Number of messages to include after the target message.

tool_schemas.name: send_message
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues an outbound message to be sent from the specified WhatsApp account into the given chat and returns the created outbound message record (including initial delivery state), de-duplicating repeated requests when client_reference_id matches a prior send for the same account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/chat_id are invalid, type is unsupported, required content for the type is missing or inconsistent (for example missing text for type=text or missing media for media types), or quoted_remote_message_id/client_reference_id are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account or chat does not exist (or the chat is not owned by the account), FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot send from that account, CONFLICT if the send is refused due to the account/session not being in a send-capable state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed configured send/rate limits.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to send from (wa_acct_... ULID).

chat_id.description: Chat id to send into (wa_chat_... ULID).

text.description: Text body for type=text, or optional caption for media types.

quoted_remote_message_id.description: Remote message id being quoted/replied to.

client_reference_id.description: Client-supplied idempotency key for de-duplicating send requests.

tool_schemas.name: search_messages
tool_schemas.description: Searches stored messages for the specified WhatsApp account using a free-text query (primarily against message text) with optional scoping to a chat and filters for direction, type, delivery_status, and timestamp range, returning a paginated list sorted by timestamp_* using limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid, query is empty, limit is outside 1–200, cursor is malformed, timestamps are invalid (including after >= before), or any enum filter/sort is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist (or chat_id is provided but does not exist/belong to the account), and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to search that account’s messages.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to search within (wa_acct_... ULID).

query.description: Free-text query matched primarily against message text (and may match other indexed fields).

chat_id.description: If provided, restrict search to a single chat (wa_chat_... ULID).

before.description: Only return messages with timestamp strictly before this time.

after.description: Only return messages with timestamp strictly after this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Sort order for message search results.

tool_schemas.name: get_account
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single WhatsApp personal-account connector record by id and returns its current status, identifiers, and session metadata. Refuses to return accounts in status='deleted'. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is not a wa_acct_… ULID, and NOT_FOUND if no matching account exists (or it is deleted).

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to fetch (wa_acct_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: create_account
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new WhatsApp personal-account connector record and starts provisioning a WhatsApp Web session. Returns the created account with status='provisioning' (or 'qr_required' if a QR is immediately available). Refuses creation if an active non-deleted account already exists for the same phone_e164 or wa_user_jid when provided, or if input fails validation.

display_name.description: Optional human-friendly label for the account.

phone_e164.description: Optional E.164 phone number to associate with the account (e.g. +14155552671).

wa_user_jid.description: Optional WhatsApp user JID if already known (e.g. 14155552671@s.whatsapp.net).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key; repeated requests with the same key return the original created account.

tool_schemas.name: update_account
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable metadata for a WhatsApp account and can drive supported lifecycle transitions such as disconnecting or deleting an account. Returns the updated account. Refuses illegal status transitions per the account lifecycle, and refuses updates to accounts in status='deleted'.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to update (wa_acct_... ULID).

display_name.description: Updated display name for the account.

status.description: Optional lifecycle transition request. Allowed values are limited to transitions an API caller can drive (e.g. connected->disconnected, *->deleted).

clear_session.description: If true, clears stored session material (session_blob) so the next connect requires a fresh login/QR.

tool_schemas.name: get_account_qr
tool_schemas.description: Returns a WhatsApp Web login QR payload for the specified account when the account is in status='qr_required'. The response includes a QR string suitable for rendering and an expiry timestamp. Refuses when the account is not in 'qr_required' or is deleted/banned.

account_id.description: WhatsApp account id to get a login QR for (wa_acct_... ULID).

metadata.name: WhatsApp Personal Account Connector
metadata.description: This backend stores a user's WhatsApp personal-account session, synced contacts, chats and messages, and an audit trail of outbound send attempts. Main workflows are: establish/maintain a WhatsApp Web session, sync chats/messages into local storage for fast search/listing, and enqueue/record outgoin
